lines.text: Zechariah sees a man with a measuring line who is going to measure Jerusalem.
Jerusalem will be a city without walls, and the LORD will be a wall of stone around it.
The LORD tells His people to flee the land of the north, and Zion to escape from Babylon.
Whoever touches God's people touches the crown on His head, and the plundering nations will become plunder for their servants.
The LORD says He is coming to dwell among them, and many nations will join themselves to the LORD.
